claims.text: Case reports: capsaicin cream gave significant relief of pain and vomiting in CHS; not established as definitive therapy
claims.quote: twenty published cases of CHS demonstrated significant relief of both pain and vomiting with capsaicin cream, though, due to various difficulties including the nascent age of this diagnosis, differing diagnostic criteria, and the lack of recruitment for large case series and randomized control trials, have not fully legitimized capsaicin use as definitive therapy for CHS.
